name: Wand of Magic Missiles
description: This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 or more charges to cast magic missile. For 1 charge, you cast the 1st-level version of the spell. You may increase the spell slot level by one for each additional charge expended. The wand regains 1d6+1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll a d20; on a 1 the wand crumbles to ashes.
